title: 奈杰尔·法拉奇辞去议员职务，挑战建制派
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I thought about it hard and I've decided today, today, I will resign as a member of Parliament for Clackton on C, thereby forcing a by-election, which should happen, I hope, in short order.
segments.zh: 我深思熟虑后决定，今天辞去克拉顿选区议员职务，从而触发补选，希望尽快举行。

segments.en: Now, I've decided that the people of Clackton should be the judges of my actions.
segments.zh: 我决定让克拉顿人民来评判我的行为。

segments.en: This will be a people versus the establishment by-election. It's a chance to stick to fingers up
segments.zh: 这将是一场人民对阵建制派的补选，是向整个建制派竖中指的机会。

segments.en: to the entire establishment to frankly tell them where to go. And that is why I will be putting my name
segments.zh: 直白地告诉他们该去哪。因此我将报名参选这场补选。

segments.en: forward to stand in this by-election. I will fight to win. I will fight to continue the political revolution that reform has started. And I would say this to you, the voters of Clackton. If I win,
segments.zh: 我会为胜利而战，继续改革党开启的政治革命。对克拉顿选民说：如果我赢，你们就赢。

segments.en: you win. Because if I lose, they win. And we will never, with the two old parties, get the type of fundamental change that we need to fix, broken, Britain.
segments.zh: 如果我输，他们就赢。两大旧党永远不会带来修复破碎英国所需的根本变革。
